verdict.rationale: Braintrust's docs describe experiments as "the immutable, comparable record of your eval runs" that you can track over time and run in CI/CD to catch regressions. Playgrounds let users run full evals and "compare results side-by-side" across prompts, models, scorers and datasets, and onboarding explicitly frames evals as comparing prompts and models. missing for 10: detailed documentation of the experiment diff view (per-test-case regression highlighting, score deltas), independent or hands-on corroboration of side-by-side comparison.
